title: Business Capability is in status Ready for too long
cardHint: A Business Capability has been in status Ready for too long. SACM makes it Operational itself.
cardText: The Business Capability was created more than the number of days in Settings ago (90 at first) and is still in status Ready. SACM makes it Operational itself in ServiceNow; Enterprise Architecture owns the capabilities and only answers questions. Mark as fixed when it is done. A line is Verified when a later report shows it Operational.
